scope: Read-only next-stage review; styles/default style/metadata remain native, no owner retired by this review.

canonical_pointer_access.GetStyle(int): Pointer getter currently consumed by immediate copy overload and GetCharSet; RTS uses the copy overload.
canonical_pointer_access.CreateDefaultStyle: Returns default-style address; active CCDecoder caller discards it.
canonical_pointer_access.SubStyle.style: Public ABI storage supplied by caller; filter getters copy STSStyle into it. No map pointer returned by those getters.
canonical_pointer_access.local_map_pointers: Named renderer reset, both filter APIs and SaveAs use local pointers/pairs; absence of more repository callers is not an external-lifetime proof.

required_behavior: Expose ATL enumeration in historical insertion/removal/copy order.
Equal duplicate AddStyle deletes incoming value without changing map order; differing duplicate removes/reinserts under generated name and renames existing entries before inserting replacement.
Preserve CString first-NUL comparisons, raw logical lengths and full-unit assignments as distinct operations.
Use native STSStyle equality: fontName CString equality and floating ==, including NaN and signed-zero behavior.
Both filter setters check count and validate every name before any updates, then consume inputs sequentially including duplicate names/null style slots; notify after updates.
Both filter getters validate each logical name length and preserve partial preceding output, wcscpy_s NUL termination, and sequential writes to possibly shared caller output storage.
Metadata assignments stay at existing points; GetStreamInfo returns LCID zero despite stored m_lcid.

order: Introduce native-backed value accessors and capture actual style API output/partial-update behavior.
Route renderer, both filter APIs and CCDecoder while retaining native canonical ownership.
Route STS internal style access/copy/export operations, then remove canonical pointer getters only from migrated configuration.
Model map ordering/key semantics and move style/default-style values into safe owner after differential evidence.
proposed_next_slice.retained_adapter: Incoming AddStyle STSStyle* ownership must be consumed/disposed at matching points; no new canonical Rust loans.

gates: Value snapshot allocation changes need explicit failure-scope review.
Actual Windows x86/x64 full class and filter style API comparisons.
Default-style and document metadata ownership remain separate work.
Host stream selection/retention audit remains required.
